\section[\texorpdfstring{\fa{رقصیدن} (raghsidan)}{رقصیدن (raghsidan)}]{\fa{رقصیدن} (raghsidan) — to dance}

\label{lesson:FA-C38-raghsidan}



\begin{quote}
Before the new one: say the Persian for to wash, then the Persian for to laugh.
\end{quote}

\subsection*{You'll want to know: \fa{رقصیدن}}
\textbf{\fa{رقصیدن}} — \emph{raghsidan} — \textquotedblleft{}to dance\textquotedblright{}.

\begin{cousinweb}
\emph{raghsidan} is built on \emph{raghs}, \textquotedblleft{}dance\textquotedblright{}, borrowed from Arabic \emph{raqṣ}, \textquotedblleft{}dancing\textquotedblright{} (root \emph{r-q-ṣ}, Lane), with the Persian verb ending \emph{-idan}.
\end{cousinweb}
